interpretation_rules: Preserve raw names, sampled-key brackets, notes and hypotheses; normalize into additional fields only.
A row's sample number, product program number and local extractor instrument ID are different namespaces until linked.
Stars describe coverage categories, not per-row confidence.
A documented original sampled key is not automatically game unity, sounding MIDI pitch or transpose.
Unknown or Stuff to Find is an unlabeled origin, not evidence for an SFX route or a negative GM class.
Imported documentary origins, local sample bindings and reviewer-accepted GM replacements are separate evidence layers.
No automatic code path consumes this catalog. No source identity or GM route has been verified by this research seed.
hash_scope: pilot selection_sha256 hashes canonical ASCII JSON of spreadsheet_id,sheet_id,game_title,game_section,raw_cells. Locators and our assessment are excluded. These are selected-cell fingerprints, not whole-sheet or workbook revision hashes.
